Scenario: Authorized user on a managed compliant endpoint
Preconditions: User is in the correct group; endpoint reports compliant
Action: Access a protected resource in the migrated environment
Expected result: Access granted; session logged and subject to reevaluation
Evidence to collect: Access log entry and policy decision record

Scenario: Authorized user on an unmanaged endpoint to a restricted cloud resource
Preconditions: Same user; endpoint not enrolled in management
Action: Attempt access to a restricted resource
Expected result: Denied or restricted according to policy
Evidence to collect: Denial event with the reason recorded

Scenario: Unauthorized user on a managed endpoint
Preconditions: User is outside the entitled group; endpoint compliant
Action: Attempt access to the protected resource
Evidence to collect: Denial event and alert if configured

Scenario: Endpoint becomes non-compliant during an active session
Preconditions: Session already established from a compliant endpoint
Action: Trigger a compliance failure, for example disable disk encryption
Expected result: Session restricted or revoked according to policy
Evidence to collect: Session termination or step-up record with timestamps

Preconditions: Calling service holds a valid workload identity
Expected result: Request succeeds and is logged against the service identity
Evidence to collect: Service log showing the authenticated identity

Preconditions: Calling service has no entitlement to the target

Scenario: Approved legacy identity exception in use
Preconditions: An open exception exists in the risk register
Action: Access the legacy path covered by the exception
Expected result: Access succeeds only through the compensating control; use is logged and linked to the register entry
Evidence to collect: Log entry cross-referenced to the risk ID

Preconditions: Exception has passed its expiry date and been closed
Action: Attempt to use the retired path
Expected result: Old path denied or the change is blocked; register entry shows closed with evidence
Evidence to collect: Denial evidence and the closure record

Scenario: Segmentation change with a known dependency
Preconditions: Dependency map complete for the segment
Expected result: Required flows continue; unapproved lateral paths are blocked

Scenario: Disaster recovery failover with policy continuity
Preconditions: DR environment available and in scope
Expected result: Identity, segmentation, logging and access policy remain effective in the DR environment
Evidence to collect: DR test record covering each of the four controls
